paragraphs.english: Heat action plans, or HAPs, have been proliferating in India in the past few years. In general, an HAP spells out when and how officials should issue heat warnings and alert hospitals and other institutions. Nagpur’s plan, for instance, calls for hospitals to set aside “cold wards” in the summer for treating heatstroke patients, and advises builders to give construction laborers a break from work on very hot days.
paragraphs.chinese: 过去几年里，印度的高温行动计划，简称HAP，不断增多。一般而言，一份高温行动计划会明确规定，官员应在何时、以何种方式发布高温预警，并通知医院和其他机构。例如，那格浦尔的计划要求医院在夏季预留“降温病房”来治疗中暑患者，并建议建筑商在酷热天气让建筑工人暂停工作、休息一下。

paragraphs.english: But implementation of existing HAPs has been uneven, according to a report from the center for Policy Research. Many lack adequate funding, it found. And their triggering thresholds often are not customized to the local climate. In some areas, high daytime temperatures alone might serve as an adequate trigger for alerts. But in other places, nighttime temperatures or humidity might be as important a gauge of risk as daytime highs.
paragraphs.chinese: 不过，政策研究中心的一份报告指出，现有高温行动计划的执行情况参差不齐。报告发现，许多计划缺乏充足资金，而且其预警触发阈值往往没有根据当地气候进行调整。在有些地区，仅白天的高温就可能足以触发预警；但在其他地方，夜间气温或湿度可能与白天最高温一样，都是重要的风险指标。

paragraphs.english: Mumbai’s April heat stroke deaths highlighted the need for more nuanced and localized warnings, researchers say. That day’s high temperature of roughly 36°C was 1°C shy of the heat wave alert threshold for coastal cities set by national meteorological authorities. But the effects of the heat were amplified by humidity — an often neglected factor in heat alert systems — and the lack of shade at the late-morning outdoor ceremony.
paragraphs.chinese: 研究人员说，孟买4月份因中暑而发生的死亡事件，凸显了建立更加精细、本地化预警的必要性。当天最高气温约为36摄氏度，比国家气象部门为沿海城市设定的热浪预警阈值低1摄氏度。但湿度——高温预警系统中一个常被忽视的因素——以及临近中午的户外仪式现场缺乏遮阴，都放大了高温的影响。

paragraphs.english: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Kotharkar’s team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions. Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk.
paragraphs.chinese: 为了改进高温行动计划，城市规划师科特卡尔的团队正在制定一份示范计划，概括最佳实践，并使其能够按照当地情况进行调整。她说，除了其他工作外，所有城市都应制作一张脆弱性地图，帮助把应对措施集中用于风险最高的人群。

paragraphs.english: Such mapping doesn’t need to be complex, Kotharkar says. “A useful map can be created by looking at even a few key parameters.” For example, neighborhoods with a large elderly population or informal dwellings that cope poorly with heat could get special warnings or be bolstered with cooling centers. The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
paragraphs.chinese: 科特卡尔表示，这种地图不必很复杂。“哪怕只考察几个关键参数，也能制作出有用的地图。”例如，老年人口较多的街区，或者临时住房较多、难以应对酷热的街区，可以收到专门预警，或通过设置降温中心加强防护。那格浦尔项目已制作出一张风险与脆弱性地图，使科特卡尔能够告诉官员，今年夏天一旦出现热浪，应重点关注哪些街区。

paragraphs.english: HAPs shouldn’t just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler. In Nagpur, for example, Kotharkar’s team has been able to advise city officials about where to plant trees to provide shade. HAPs could also guide efforts to retrofit homes or modify building regulations. “Reducing deaths in an emergency is a good target to have, but it’s the lowest target,” says Climate researcher Chandni Singh.
paragraphs.chinese: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不仅应包含短期应急措施，还应建议采取能够让社区降温的中长期措施。例如，在那格浦尔，科特卡尔的团队已经能够建议市政官员，在什么地方植树可以提供遮阴。高温行动计划还可以指导住宅改造或建筑规范调整。气候研究人员钱德妮·辛格说：“减少紧急情况下的死亡人数，是一个值得设定的目标，但也是最低层次的目标。”
